facts.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/psdisp:psDispParticles
facts.version_note: updated_at identifies the frozen baseline fact version.
facts.value: When sw is 0, the function performs no drawing: it increments psFrameNum while it is below 255, otherwise wraps it to 1, then returns. For a nonzero pass it scans all 16 render-link slots selected by target_link. Pass 1 starts at the full TexEdge-first sorted list and stops when the first non-TexEdge particle is reached; the other drawing pass starts directly at the non-TexEdge partition. Zero-sized particles are skipped. Common GX state is initialized only when the first drawable particle is encountered, while alpha-test parameters, TexEdge depth-write mode, fog enablement, texture mirroring, palette and image bindings, filtering, and other render settings are changed only when requested particle state differs from cached state. The function invalidates HSD render state only if that lazy setup occurred.
facts.reason: Makes input, ownership, cache and unsafe-path boundaries explicit.
